xna-type.name: ContentProcessorContext
xna-type.summary: Provides access to custom processor parameters, methods for converting member data, and triggering nested builds.
xna-type.remarks: The context object, passed into a content processor, indicates any custom parameters or requests. For instance, a mesh processor could use this to force any textures used by the processor to be built when the mesh object is built.

constructor.summary: This constructor is available only when developing for Windows.

property.name: BuildConfiguration
property.summary: Gets the name of the current content build configuration.

property.name: IntermediateDirectory
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The path of the directory that will contain any intermediate files that the content processor will produce.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Gets the logger interface used for status messages or warnings.
property.value: Logger interface used by the processor.

property.name: OutputDirectory
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The directory path of the output file that the content processor will produce.

property.name: OutputFilename
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The name of the output file that the content processor will produce.

property.name: Parameters
property.summary: Gets the collection of parameters used by the content processor.

property.name: TargetPlatform
property.summary: Gets the current content build target platform.
property.value: Name of the target platform for the current content build.

property.name: TargetProfile
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The enumeration that identifies the graphics profile of the device.

method.name: AddDependency
method.summary: Adds a dependency to the specified file. This causes a rebuild of the file, when modified, on subsequent incremental builds.

method.name: BuildAndLoadAsset
method.summary: Initiates a nested build of the specified asset and then loads the result into memory.

overload.returns: Copy of the final converted content.
overload.remarks: An example of usage would be a mesh processor calling BuildAndLoadAsset to build any associated textures and replace the original .tga file references with an embedded copy of the converted texture.

method.name: BuildAsset
method.summary: Initiates a nested build of an additional asset.

overload.signature: BuildAsset(Generic ExternalReference, String, OpaqueDataDictionary, String, String)
overload.summary: Initiates a nested build of an additional asset.
overload.syntax: public ExternalReference<TOutput> BuildAsset<TInput,TOutput> ( ExternalReference<TInput> sourceAsset, string processorName, OpaqueDataDictionary processorParameters, string importerName, string assetName )

parameters.parameter: Optional collection of named values available as input to the content processor.
Optional name of the final compiled content.

overload.returns: Reference to the final compiled content. The build work is not required to complete before returning. Therefore, this file may not be up to date when BuildAsset returns but it will be available for loading by the game at runtime.
overload.remarks: An example of usage for BuildAsset is being called by a mesh processor to request that any related textures used are also built, replacing the original TGA file references with new references to the converted texture files.
